rotationSign: CSS rotate(); positive = clockwise on screen

parts.description: Far hind leg (darker tone); pivot at the hip (+ back, - forward).
Far front leg (darker tone); pivot at the shoulder (+ back, - forward).
Tail with dark tuft; pivot at the tail root on the rump (+ swings the tuft out behind, - tucks it toward the legs; near -30 the tuft hides behind the near hind leg, so -15 to +30 reads best).
Torso with neck, black patches and udder; pivot near the centre of mass for a gentle sway or tilt.
Near hind leg with a black patch; pivot at the hip (+ back, - forward).
Near front leg and hoof; pivot at the shoulder (+ swings the hoof back, - swings it forward).
Head with muzzle, eye, ear and both horns; pivot at the neck joint (+ nods down to eat, - lifts).
